_README: THE ACCEPTED-OUTCOME RECORD FOR THE FEATURE SUITE. Read by
.github/scripts/assert-known-test-outcomes.php, which is a BLOCKING step of the required
`tests` job. The gate asserts this SET in both directions: a failure or skip that is not
listed here fails CI, and a listed entry that starts passing ALSO fails CI, because the
record has become a lie and the entry must be deleted.
WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT. It is not a list of things currently broken, and it is not a place
to park a red test. Every entry names a root cause with a file:line and the workstream that
owns the fix. Adding an entry to make CI green is the one use of this file that is
forbidden; if a new failure appears, it is a regression until someone proves otherwise.
MEASURED on p1f/agent5-ci against vendor/ as installed in the development container
vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Feature  ->  1126 tests, 6135 assertions, 0 errors, 8 failures, 17 skipped
Note that those numbers come from a vendor/ tree that does NOT match composer.lock (148 of
239 packages differ). The required `tests` job installs from the lock, which is the whole
point of making it required -- and which is why it cannot pass until the dead
lahirulhr/laravel-payhere package is resolved. See docs/BUILD-REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
There is deliberately NO section for errors. The suite's zero-errors property is enforced
unconditionally: an error means a test could not run at all.
_require_reason_log_note: Fail the gate if no --log-teamcity log is supplied. The skip REASONS cannot be read from
JUnit at all -- PHPUnit 11.5.57 writes a bare <skipped/> with no message -- so the reason
half of the gate depends on a second log. Making its absence a FAILURE is what stops one
dropped CI flag from disabling a control in silence.
_minimum_testcases_note: A floor, not the count. Its only job is to stop the gate passing on a log from a run that
died early -- every set comparison in the checker is trivially satisfied by an empty log.
The real count at the time of writing is 1126 Feature testcases. Lower this ONLY when tests
are removed on purpose, and record why here.

Tests\\Feature\\Auth\\AuthenticationTest.cause: NEW-ADDON-SCHEMA-02: no such table: owner_menu_settings. packages/workdo/LandingPage/src/Providers/LandingPageServiceProvider.php:28 calls loadMigrationsFrom(__DIR__ . '/../database/Migrations') while the directory on disk is src/database/migrations (lowercase m). The path does not exist on a case-sensitive filesystem, so six migrations are never discovered -- one of which creates owner_menu_settings, which resources/views/layouts/guest.blade.php:96 reads on every guest screen.
Tests\\Feature\\Auth\\AuthenticationTest.owner: OWNER DECISION. The file is inside packages/workdo/, which .github/scripts/guard-no-workdo-changes.sh refuses to let a pull request modify: an in-place edit to a vendored commercial module is reverted by the next upstream update and leaves no patch record.

A REAL APPLICATION DEFECT, not the casing bug. app/Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisteredUserController.php:249 calls $user->addRole($role_r) with no null guard, and Role::where('name','admin')->first() is null on a database whose roles are not seeded. The user, the store and the login are all committed first, so a merchant is left half-provisioned: authenticated, pointed at a store, and holding no role. The test asserts the role, which is the property that matters.
Tests\\Feature\\Auth\\RegistrationTest::.owner: app/ -- NOT owned by the CI workstream. Needs a null guard plus a decision about what to do when the role is absent (the half-provisioned row should not survive).
Tests\\Feature\\Auth\\RegistrationTest::.proof_it_is_not_the_casing_bug: tests/Feature/Platform/AddonMigrationStrandingTest.php shows POST /register still fails to assign the role with every stranded table present.

Tests\\Feature\\ProfileTest::test_profil.cause: A REAL APPLICATION DEFECT, and a DIFFERENT one from the other seven. GET /profile answers 500 with ErrorException: Attempt to read property "slug" on null at app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:367 (`route('landing_page', $store->slug)`). /profile is served by UserController@profile, not by Breeze's ProfileController@edit, so this test exercises the real merchant profile page.
Tests\\Feature\\ProfileTest::test_profil.owner: app/ -- NOT owned by the CI workstream. Needs a null-store guard at HomeController.php:367 (and :369, the same expression in the sibling branch).
Tests\\Feature\\ProfileTest::test_profil.proof_it_is_not_the_casing_bug: tests/Feature/Platform/AddonMigrationStrandingTest::test_the_profile_page_failure_is_not_this_bug asserts the 500 persists with every stranded table present, and reddens if it is ever fixed.

_gate_f_coverage_gap: SEVENTEEN SKIPS DO NOT MEAN THE SIX MONEY TABLES ARE WELL COVERED, and the record should not
be read that way. Of the six, store_wallets, store_wallet_transactions, store_withdrawals,
store_order_financials, currency_rates and delivery_earnings now ALL appear above -- the
FinancialSurfaceCoverageTest entries closed the three that previously had no skip at all.
tests/Unit/Database/GateFCoverageLedgerTest.php holds the authoritative per-table ledger and
ratchets it. Two of the seventeen (newsletters.user_id, zid_orders) are SCHEMA-01 undeclared
tables OUTSIDE the six, and are recorded as such above rather than folded into GATE F.
